purpose: Read-only preflight for an independent Autodesk RCP point-count check.
result: The Revit 2027 AdskRcManaged.dll is a mixed C++/CLI x64 assembly targeting .NET 10. Static metadata exposes RCProject.LoadFromFile and GetNumberOfPoints. Loading it from the available standalone PowerShell 7.6.5 / .NET 10.0.11 process failed with FileNotFoundException: Could not load file or assembly; adding the Revit DLL directory to PATH did not resolve it. Revit was not launched, and no RCP/RCS or project data was opened or changed.
limits: The error does not identify the missing native dependency; it does not prove that Revit is strictly required.
No independent Autodesk point-count value was obtained.
Existing application reader counts remain unvalidated against an independent SDK count.

external_research.relevant_finding: Autodesk documents that ReCap may exclude points because of import decimation, a one-point-per-cubic-millimeter density limit, unit mismatch, and coordinate precision. This is a plausible source of RCP manifest versus RCS reader count differences, but it does not establish the cause for this project.
external_research.title: Autodesk: Not all scan points are used when creating or importing a ReCap Point Cloud

external_research.relevant_finding: Autodesk lists RCS as a point-cloud format and RCP/RCS as supported exports.
external_research.title: Autodesk ReCap: Supported file formats

acceptance: Stage 2 stays open: count semantics and a successful ReCap GUI round-trip are still required.
